1330.2001.1.description:
RSTP, L2_unicast, power_cycle

[Log-derived analysis] Layer-2 redundancy under RSTP. Builds a multi-member stack plus partner switches with RSTP running for loop prevention, runs a steady L2 unicast traffic stream and confirms baseline connectivity over a loop-free topology. It then hardware power-cycles the stack Active Master to force an unplanned failover and analyses captured-packet gaps for disruption. Confirms spanning-tree keeps the L2 topology loop-free and re-converges across the failover. Verifies the backup member takes over as stack Active Master, the rebooted unit cleanly rejoins and resyncs the stack, stack ports return to their expected state, channel-group/LAG diagnostics stay clean, per-failover traffic disruption stays within acceptable thresholds, the running-config is preserved after teardown, and no exceptions or core dumps occur.

1330.5001.1.description:
IPv4 unicast VRRP. Stack is VRRP master, power_cycle

[Log-derived analysis] First-hop redundancy under VRRP (IPv4 unicast) with the stack as the VRRP master. Builds a multi-member stack plus partner switches, configures VRRP and confirms the expected VRRP role/state, runs a steady unicast traffic stream through the virtual router and confirms baseline connectivity.
